> 译注：文中的性能、安全性和“首个”等表述来自上游项目，尚未独立验证。原文两个一键部署短链及 G2、npm 网页本次检查返回 HTTP 403；可参阅 [Payload 官方部署文档](https://payloadcms.com/docs/production/deployment)及 [npm 官方注册表](https://registry.npmjs.org/payload)。原链接保留，一键部署可用性未确认。

         

浏览文档 · 社区帮助 · 路线图 · 查看 G2 评价

> [!IMPORTANT] > 给仓库加星或关注它，以便跟踪项目进展。 Payload 自称是首个可直接安装到现有 `/app` 文件夹的 Next.js 原生 CMS，并称其开启了无头 CMS 的新时代。

相比普通 CMS 的优势

  • 既是应用框架，也是无头 CMS
  • 可部署在任何地方，包括在 Vercel 免费使用无服务器部署
  • 如有需要，可将前后端合并到同一个 /app 文件夹
  • 无需再注册一个 SaaS——Payload 是开源的
  • 在 React Server Components 中查询数据库
  • 管理界面与后端均可完全扩展
  • 不受供应商锁定
  • 不再需要接触古老的 WP 代码
  • 更快构建，不再遇到障碍
## 快速开始 开始使用 Payload 前，请确保已具备所有[所需软件](https://payloadcms.com/docs/getting-started/installation). ```text pnpx create-payload-app@latest ``` **如果你是 Payload 新手，应从网站模板开始**（`pnpx create-payload-app@latest -t website`）。它展示了如何完成_各种操作_，包括自定义富文本块、按需重新验证、实时预览等。模板包含使用 Tailwind 构建的前端，所有内容都位于同一个 `/app` 文件夹中。 ## 一键部署选项 可以通过 Vercel 和 Cloudflare 一键无服务器部署 Payload，获得所需组件而不必处理底层配置。 ### 部署到 Cloudflare 完整独立——一键部署 Payload，并使用 **Workers**、用于上传的 **R2** 和用于全球复制数据库的 **D1**。 [![Deploy to Cloudflare](https://deploy.workers.cloudflare.com/button)](https://dub.sh/payload-cloudflare) ### 部署到 Vercel 在 Vercel 上一体化部署——一键部署 Payload，包含 **Next.js** 前端、**Neon** 数据库和用于媒体存储的 **Vercel Blob**。 [![Deploy with Vercel](https://vercel.com/button)](https://dub.sh/payload-vercel) ## 一键模板 使用现成模板快速开始下一个项目。这些模板是旨在帮助你快速进入市场的**可用于生产的端到端解决方案**。可以构建**网站**、**电商商店**、**博客**或**作品集**，并配有使用 **React Server Components** 和 **Tailwind** 构建的现代前端。 #### 🌐 [网站](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/tree/be95e1a17acfa9979bd6c9d34565708a3c833e68/templates/website) #### 🛍️ [电商](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/tree/be95e1a17acfa9979bd6c9d34565708a3c833e68/templates/ecommerce) 🎉 _**新增**_ 🎉 我们持续向[**模板目录**](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/tree/be95e1a17acfa9979bd6c9d34565708a3c833e68/templates). 添加更多模板。如果维护自己的模板，请为 GitHub 仓库添加 `payload-template` 主题，以便其他人发现。 **🔗 探索更多：** - [官方模板](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/tree/be95e1a17acfa9979bd6c9d34565708a3c833e68/templates) - [社区模板](https://github.com/topics/payload-template) ## ✨ Payload 功能 - 完全免费且开源 - Next.js 原生，旨在运行于_你的_ `/app` 文件夹中 - 使用服务端组件扩展 Payload UI - 在服务端组件中直接查询数据库，无需 REST / GraphQL - 完全使用 TypeScript，为数据自动生成类型 - [开箱即用的认证](https://payloadcms.com/docs/authentication/overview) - [版本与草稿](https://payloadcms.com/docs/versions/overview) - [本地化](https://payloadcms.com/docs/configuration/localization) - [基于区块的布局构建器](https://payloadcms.com/docs/fields/blocks) - [可定制的 React 管理界面](https://payloadcms.com/docs/admin/overview) - [Lexical 富文本编辑器](https://payloadcms.com/docs/fields/rich-text) - [条件字段逻辑](https://payloadcms.com/docs/fields/overview#conditional-logic) - 极细粒度的[访问控制](https://payloadcms.com/docs/access-control/overview) - [文档和字段级钩子](https://payloadcms.com/docs/hooks/overview)覆盖 Payload 提供的每项操作 - 速度极快的 API - 借助 HTTP-only Cookie、CSRF 防护等机制提供高安全性 请求功能 ## 🗒️ 文档 请查看 [Payload 网站](https://payloadcms.com/docs/getting-started/what-is-payload)，了解 Payload 所提供功能的深入文档。 从 v2 迁移到 v3？请参阅 [3.0 迁移指南](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/blob/be95e1a17acfa9979bd6c9d34565708a3c833e68/docs/migration-guide/overview.mdx)了解如何操作。 ## 🙋 贡献 如果想为此仓库做贡献，请遵循 [contributing.md](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/blob/be95e1a17acfa9979bd6c9d34565708a3c833e68/CONTRIBUTING.md). ## 📚 示例 [示例目录](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/tree/be95e1a17acfa9979bd6c9d34565708a3c833e68/examples)是学习通过不同方式配置 Payload 的资源；我们的博客和社交媒体中也有示例。 如果想运行示例，可以使用 `create-payload-app` 从示例创建项目： ```sh npx create-payload-app --example example_name ``` 可以在以下位置查看更多示例： - [示例目录](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/tree/be95e1a17acfa9979bd6c9d34565708a3c833e68/examples) - [Payload 博客](https://payloadcms.com/blog) - [Payload YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@payloadcms) ## 🔌 插件 Payload 高度可扩展，允许安装或分发增加或移除功能的插件。既有官方支持的插件，也有社区支持的插件。如果维护自己的插件，可以考虑为 GitHub 仓库添加 `payload-plugin` 主题，方便他人发现。 - [官方插件](https://github.com/orgs/payloadcms/repositories?q=topic%3Apayload-plugin) - [社区插件](https://github.com/topics/payload-plugin) ## 🚨 需要帮助？ GitHub Discussions 和 Discord 服务器中有大量讨论和资源。如果遇到困难，可能已经有人解决过类似问题。:point_down: - [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/discussions) - [GitHub 问题](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/issues) - [Discord](https://t.co/30APlsQUPB) - [社区帮助](https://payloadcms.com/community-help) ## ⭐ 喜欢我们的工作？请给我们一颗星 ## 👏 感谢所有贡献者
en:
Explore the Docs · Community Help · Roadmap · View G2 Reviews

> [!IMPORTANT] > Star this repo or keep an eye on it to follow along. Payload is the first-ever Next.js native CMS that can install directly in your existing `/app` folder. It's the start of a new era for headless CMS.

Benefits over a regular CMS

  • It's both an app framework & headless CMS
  • Deploy anywhere, including serverless on Vercel for free
  • Combine your front+backend in the same /app folder if you want
  • Don't sign up for yet another SaaS - Payload is open source
  • Query your database in React Server Components
  • Both admin and backend are 100% extensible
  • No vendor lock-in
  • Never touch ancient WP code again
  • Build faster, never hit a roadblock
## Quickstart Before beginning to work with Payload, make sure you have all of the [required software](https://payloadcms.com/docs/getting-started/installation). ```text pnpx create-payload-app@latest ``` **If you're new to Payload, you should start with the website template** (`pnpx create-payload-app@latest -t website`). It shows how to do _everything_ - including custom Rich Text blocks, on-demand revalidation, live preview, and more. It comes with a frontend built with Tailwind all in one `/app` folder. ## One-click deployment options You can deploy Payload serverlessly in one-click via Vercel and Cloudflare—giving everything you need without the hassle of the plumbing. ### Deploy on Cloudflare Fully self-contained — one click to deploy Payload with **Workers**, **R2** for uploads, and **D1** for a globally replicated database. [![Deploy to Cloudflare](https://deploy.workers.cloudflare.com/button)](https://dub.sh/payload-cloudflare) ### Deploy on Vercel All-in-one on Vercel — one click to deploy Payload with a **Next.js** front end, **Neon** database, and **Vercel Blob** for media storage. [![Deploy with Vercel](https://vercel.com/button)](https://dub.sh/payload-vercel) ## One-click templates Jumpstart your next project with a ready-to-go template. These are **production-ready, end-to-end solutions** designed to get you to market fast. Build any kind of **website**, **ecommerce store**, **blog**, or **portfolio** — complete with a modern front end built using **React Server Components** and **Tailwind**. #### 🌐 [Website](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/tree/be95e1a17acfa9979bd6c9d34565708a3c833e68/templates/website) #### 🛍️ [Ecommerce](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/tree/be95e1a17acfa9979bd6c9d34565708a3c833e68/templates/ecommerce) 🎉 _**NEW**_ 🎉 We're constantly adding more templates to our [**Templates Directory**](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/tree/be95e1a17acfa9979bd6c9d34565708a3c833e68/templates). If you maintain your own, add the `payload-template` topic to your GitHub repo so others can discover it. **🔗 Explore more:** - [Official Templates](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/tree/be95e1a17acfa9979bd6c9d34565708a3c833e68/templates) - [Community Templates](https://github.com/topics/payload-template) ## ✨ Payload Features - Completely free and open-source - Next.js native, built to run inside _your_ `/app` folder - Use server components to extend Payload UI - Query your database directly in server components, no need for REST / GraphQL - Fully TypeScript with automatic types for your data - [Auth out of the box](https://payloadcms.com/docs/authentication/overview) - [Versions and drafts](https://payloadcms.com/docs/versions/overview) - [Localization](https://payloadcms.com/docs/configuration/localization) - [Block-based layout builder](https://payloadcms.com/docs/fields/blocks) - [Customizable React admin](https://payloadcms.com/docs/admin/overview) - [Lexical rich text editor](https://payloadcms.com/docs/fields/rich-text) - [Conditional field logic](https://payloadcms.com/docs/fields/overview#conditional-logic) - Extremely granular [Access Control](https://payloadcms.com/docs/access-control/overview) - [Document and field-level hooks](https://payloadcms.com/docs/hooks/overview) for every action Payload provides - Intensely fast API - Highly secure thanks to HTTP-only cookies, CSRF protection, and more Request Feature ## 🗒️ Documentation Check out the [Payload website](https://payloadcms.com/docs/getting-started/what-is-payload) to find in-depth documentation for everything that Payload offers. Migrating from v2 to v3? Check out the [3.0 Migration Guide](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/blob/be95e1a17acfa9979bd6c9d34565708a3c833e68/docs/migration-guide/overview.mdx) on how to do it. ## 🙋 Contributing If you want to add contributions to this repository, please follow the instructions in [contributing.md](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/blob/be95e1a17acfa9979bd6c9d34565708a3c833e68/CONTRIBUTING.md). ## 📚 Examples The [Examples Directory](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/tree/be95e1a17acfa9979bd6c9d34565708a3c833e68/examples) is a great resource for learning how to setup Payload in a variety of different ways, but you can also find great examples in our blog and throughout our social media. If you'd like to run the examples, you can use `create-payload-app` to create a project from one: ```sh npx create-payload-app --example example_name ``` You can see more examples at: - [Examples Directory](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/tree/be95e1a17acfa9979bd6c9d34565708a3c833e68/examples) - [Payload Blog](https://payloadcms.com/blog) - [Payload YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@payloadcms) ## 🔌 Plugins Payload is highly extensible and allows you to install or distribute plugins that add or remove functionality. There are both officially-supported and community-supported plugins available. If you maintain your own plugin, consider adding the `payload-plugin` topic to your GitHub repository for others to find. - [Official Plugins](https://github.com/orgs/payloadcms/repositories?q=topic%3Apayload-plugin) - [Community Plugins](https://github.com/topics/payload-plugin) ## 🚨 Need help? There are lots of good conversations and resources in our Github Discussions board and our Discord Server. If you're struggling with something, chances are, someone's already solved what you're up against. :point_down: - [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/discussions) - [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/issues) - [Discord](https://t.co/30APlsQUPB) - [Community Help](https://payloadcms.com/community-help) ## ⭐ Like what we're doing? Give us a star ## 👏 Thanks to all our contributors
